adds.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
adds.text: Logan clashes with Xavier over the blocks Xavier placed in Jean's mind, then follows him into her childhood home, where Jean destroys him before Logan's eyes.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Clashes with Logan over Jean's mind, and dies in front of him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Challenges Xavier over Jean, then watches him die.
adds.evidence: In the infirmary Logan angrily confronts Xavier for caging Jean's mind; at the Grey house Logan, pinned to the ceiling, watches Jean disintegrate Xavier.

adds.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
adds.text: When Bobby reminds Logan there are only six of them left, Logan rallies him to fight Magneto at Alcatraz. There Logan asks Bobby to take down Pyro, and Bobby goes after him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Answers Logan's call to fight, and takes on Pyro for him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Rallies Bobby to fight and sends him after Pyro.
adds.evidence: In the mansion tunnels Bobby says there are only six of them, Logan gives his speech and Bobby says they're in; at Alcatraz Logan asks Bobby if he can take down his old friend Pyro.

adds.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
adds.text: Logan runs Kitty's Danger Room session, then rallies her and the other young X-Men to stand with him against Magneto at Alcatraz.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: One of the last X-Men who follow Logan to Alcatraz.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Rallies Kitty to fight at Alcatraz.
adds.evidence: Logan subs for Scott in the Danger Room with Kitty among the team; later he tells Bobby, Kitty and Peter they are outnumbered but must fight, and they sign they're ready before flying to Alcatraz.

adds.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
adds.text: While Scott grieves for Jean, Xavier worries he is a changed man. When Scott meets Jean at Alkali Lake, Xavier senses his distress and sends Logan and Storm after him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The grieving student whose distress Xavier senses at Alkali Lake.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Senses Scott's distress and sends help.
adds.evidence: Xavier tells Storm that Scott is a changed man after Jean's death and asks Logan to cover for him; later Xavier senses Scott's distress telepathically (Scott's name echoes through the school) and sends Logan and Storm to Alkali Lake.

adds.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
adds.text: When Rogue bursts in to ask whether mutants can really be cured, Xavier admits it appears to be true.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A student who asks Xavier if the cure is real.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Admits to Rogue the cure seems real.
adds.evidence: After Hank's news, Rogue walks in and asks if it is true they can cure them; Xavier admits it appears to be true before Storm insists there is nothing to cure.

adds.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
adds.text: In Xavier's ethics class, Kitty answers him by quoting Einstein on ethics, and Xavier jokes that Einstein wasn't a mutant, as far as they know.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A student who quotes Einstein in Xavier's ethics class.
adds.evidence: During Xavier's lesson on the misuse of power, Kitty remarks that Einstein said ethics are an exclusively human concern; Xavier replies that Einstein wasn't a mutant, as far as they know.

adds.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
adds.text: Kitty and Peter train together in the Danger Room and are two of the last three students who sign on when Logan rallies the X-Men to fight at Alcatraz.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow young X-Man beside Kitty at Alcatraz.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow young X-Man beside Peter at Alcatraz.
adds.evidence: Both are in the Danger Room session; in the mansion tunnels Bobby looks at Kitty and Peter, they both signal they're ready, and the six X-Men fly to Alcatraz and hold the line together.

adds.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
adds.text: Storm faces Magneto at Jean's childhood home, then leads the X-Men against his army at Alcatraz, hiding them from him in a fog so Logan and Hank can strike at him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Leads the army Storm fights at Alcatraz.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hides the X-Men from Magneto in a fog at Alcatraz.
adds.evidence: Outside the Grey house Magneto confronts Xavier, Logan and Storm; at Alcatraz Storm creates fog at Logan's request so Magneto and Phoenix cannot find the X-Men, and Logan distracts Magneto while Hank cures him.

owner_calls.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
owner_calls.question: Storm flies to Alkali Lake to look for Scott and later mourns at his grave, but they never share a scene. Add a stage for her searching for him, or leave it?
options: ally: Storm searches Alkali Lake for Scott and mourns him
owner_calls.evidence: Xavier sends Logan and Storm to Alkali Lake after sensing Scott's distress; they find only his glasses and Jean.
